description:
## What

Extract §6.1.4(a)+(b) PolicyMappings (lines 2440–2514) into `pub(crate) fn apply_policy_mappings(cert: &Certificate, state: &mut WorkingState, ...) -> Result<()>`.

## Risk

HIGH.

## PKITS coverage gap (PKIX-als9 design §5)

> "PolicyMappings + anyPolicy parents when policy_mapping==0 — exercised by ≤2 tests; risky for H8."

Reviewers should consider whether to import additional PKITS policy-mapping fixtures BEFORE landing H8. Out of scope for this bead; flag in PR review.

## Ordering invariant (PKIX-als9 design §7)

> "§6.1.4(h) counter-decrement ordering: must be after mappings (§6.1.4(b)), before clamps (§6.1.4(i)/(j)). If H8 extracted, call-order in chain_walk becomes a load-bearing audit point. Must be commented at call site after refactor."

## Dependencies

- H7 (sequenced).
- prep2 (WorkingState struct — needed for `state` param).

## Acceptance

- New helper.
- chain_walk call site has explicit comment: "Order matters: H8 (mappings, §6.1.4(b)) must run before §6.1.4(h) counter decrement."
- PKITS §4.8–§4.12 (policy-mapping suite) all pass.
- clippy clean.
- No behaviour change.
title: als9: H8 — extract apply_policy_mappings (~75 lines, §6.1.4(a)+(b))
